name: Egyptian Rat Screw
tagline: Court cards set challenges, doubles get slapped. Win every card with quick hands and luck.
rulesSummary: Win every card. All the cards are dealt face down, one pile each. In turn, turn over your top card onto the middle.

An ace or court card sets a challenge: the next player gets 1 try for a jack, 2 for a queen, 3 for a king, 4 for an ace to turn up another ace or court card. If they do, the challenge passes on; if not, whoever set it takes the pile and starts the next one.
Doubles (two of a rank, one on the other) can be slapped by anyone, any time, even just before a challenge winner collects. The quickest hand takes the pile and turns up next.
Lobby options add more slaps: a sandwich (7-2-7), the top card matching the bottom one, a marriage (K and Q together), and tens (two cards adding to 10, ace = 1).
A wrong slap burns one of your cards under the pile, and you can't slap that card again.
Out of cards? You're still in: slap your way back. With a time limit (a lobby option), the most cards wins.
